144	/-- Shape of the locals of `enterFrame` (§72) and of an allocation (§71.1): each element is an
145	optional structural parent (a place index) and a `kind`. Every element is owned by the holder
146	receiving the shape. -/
147	abbrev LocalShape := List (Option Nat × Nat)
148	
149	/-- External contract `K` (§48, §80): `DeclaredDisjoint` on regions (§23, §61.3);
150	`SharedMutable` and `Pinned` on leaves (§68.1, §63.5); `ExternalDone` and `Deallocable` on places
151	(§75, §70.2); `FreeCompat place auth` (§70.2); `Satisfiable provider shape s` (§71). Obligations of
152	`K` are hypotheses of theorems, never fields. -/
153	structure K where
154	  DeclaredDisjoint : List Nat → List Nat → Prop
155	  SharedMutable : Nat → Prop
156	  Pinned : Nat → Prop
157	  ExternalDone : Nat → Prop
158	  Deallocable : Nat → Prop
159	  FreeCompat : Nat → Nat → Prop
160	  Satisfiable : Nat → LocalShape → S3 → Prop
161	
162	/-- `DDSound(K)` (§80, §23): no declared disjointness relates two regions sharing a leaf. -/
163	def DDSound (k : K) : Prop := ∀ r r', k.DeclaredDisjoint r r' → ∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r'
164	
165	/-- `origin` link of authority `i` (§42). -/
166	def S3.org (s : S3) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (s.A[i]?).bind (·.origin)
167	
168	/-- Strict ancestors of authority `i` along its origin chain (§42, §43). -/
169	def S3.ancs (s : S3) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chain s.org i
170	
171	/-- Effective anchor of `x` (§44): the root reached along its origin chain, the last element of
172	`x :: s.ancs x`. -/
173	def S3.effAnchor (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Nat := (s.ancs x).getLastD x
174	
175	/-- Active authority (§42); as an anchor, a valid anchor (§44). -/
176	def S3.Active (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Prop := ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y ∧ y.active = true
177	
178	/-- Decidability of `S3.Active` (§42, §44). -/
179	instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Decidable (s.Active x) :=
180	  match h : s.A[x]? with
181	  | some y => if hy : y.active = true then isTrue ⟨y, h, hy⟩
182	    else isFalse fun ⟨y', h', hy'⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact hy hy'
183	  | none => isFalse fun ⟨_, h', _⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'
184	
185	/-- Current frame, the top of the stack (§39). -/
186	def S3.top (s : S3) : Nat := s.F.headD 0

188	/-! ## Decidable helpers -/
189	
190	/-- Predicate on an optional value, `P y` for `some y` and `d` for `none`; used to read the
191	components of `S3` (§38). -/
192	def OptP {α : Type} (o : Option α) (P : α → Prop) (d : Prop) : Prop :=
193	  match o with
194	  | some y => P y
195	  | none => d
196	
197	/-- Decidability of `OptP` (§38). -/
198	instance {α : Type} (o : Option α) (P : α → Prop) (d : Prop) [DecidablePred P] [Decidable d] :
199	    Decidable (OptP o P d) :=
200	  match o with
201	  | some y => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (P y))
202	  | none => inferInstanceAs (Decidable d)
203	
204	/-- An index with a value is in range (§38: identities are list indices). -/
205	theorem lt_of_getElem? {α : Type} {l : List α} {i : Nat} {x : α} (h : l[i]? = some x) :
206	    i < l.length := (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 h).1
207	
208	/-! ## Least fixed points on a bounded universe
209	
210	`Usable` (§40), `FrameOf` (§40), `OwnedIn` (§40) and `ExercisableAt` (§43) are inductive
211	predicates, each the least fixed point of a monotone rule over identities below a bound `n`; the
212	Kleene iteration is stable after `n + 1` steps, which makes them decidable. -/
213	
214	/-- `k`-th Kleene iterate of a rule `R` on Boolean predicates over `Nat` (decision procedure for
215	§40 and §43). -/
216	def kiter (R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool) : Nat → Nat → Bool
217	  | 0, _ => false
218	  | k + 1, a => R (kiter R k) a
219	
220	/-- A monotone rule whose conclusions lie below `n` and which reads its premise only below `n`
221	(decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
222	structure KRule (n : Nat) (R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool) : Prop where
223	  mono : ∀ p q : Nat → Bool, (∀ a, p a = true → q a = true) → ∀ a, R p a = true → R q a = true
224	  bound : ∀ p a, R p a = true → a < n
225	  loc : ∀ p q : Nat → Bool, (∀ a, a < n → p a = q a) → ∀ a, R p a = R q a
226	
227	/-- The iteration of a monotone rule is increasing (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
228	theorem kiter_mono {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) :
229	    ∀ k a, kiter R k a = true → kiter R (k + 1) a = true
230	  | 0, _, hk => by simp [kiter] at hk
231	  | k + 1, a, hk => h.mono _ _ (kiter_mono h k) a hk
232	
233	/-- Conclusions of the iteration lie below the bound (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
234	theorem kiter_bound {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) :
235	    ∀ k a, kiter R k a = true → a < n
236	  | 0, _, hk => by simp [kiter] at hk
237	  | _ + 1, a, hk => h.bound _ a hk
238	
239	/-- `countP` is monotone in the predicate (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
240	theorem countP_le_of {l : List Nat} {p q : Nat → Bool} (hpq : ∀ a ∈ l, p a = true → q a = true) :
241	    l.countP p ≤ l.countP q := by
242	  induction l with
243	  | nil => simp
244	  | cons a l ih =>
245	    simp only [List.countP_cons]
246	    have := ih fun b hb => hpq b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)
247	    cases hp : p a <;> cases hq : q a <;> simp_all <;> omega
248	
249	/-- `countP` grows strictly when one more element satisfies the predicate (decision procedure
250	for §40 and §43). -/
251	theorem countP_lt_of {l : List Nat} {p q : Nat → Bool} (hpq : ∀ a ∈ l, p a = true → q a = true)
252	    {x : Nat} (hx : x ∈ l) (hqx : q x = true) (hpx : p x = false) : l.countP p < l.countP q := by
253	  induction l with
254	  | nil => simp at hx
255	  | cons a l ih =>
256	    simp only [List.countP_cons]
257	    have hle := countP_le_of (l := l) fun b hb => hpq b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)
258	    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hx with rfl | hx
259	    · simp [hqx, hpx]; omega
260	    · have := ih (fun b hb => hpq b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)) hx
261	      cases hp : p a <;> cases hq : q a <;> simp_all <;> omega
262	
263	/-- A failed `all` has a witness (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
264	theorem all_false_exists {α : Type} {p : α → Bool} : ∀ {l : List α}, l.all p = false →
265	    ∃ a ∈ l, p a = false
266	  | [], h => by simp at h
267	  | a :: l, h => by
268	    simp only [List.all_cons, Bool.and_eq_false_iff] at h
269	    rcases h with h | h
270	    · exact ⟨a, List.mem_cons_self .., h⟩
271	    · obtain ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ := all_false_exists h; exact ⟨b, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb, hb'⟩
272	
273	/-- Stability of the iteration at step `k`, below `n` (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
274	def kstab (R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool) (n k : Nat) : Bool :=
275	  (List.range n).all fun a => kiter R (k + 1) a == kiter R k a
276	
277	/-- A stable iteration stays stable one step later (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
278	theorem kstab_succ {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) {k : Nat}
279	    (hs : kstab R n k = true) : kstab R n (k + 1) = true := by
280	  simp only [kstab, List.all_eq_true, List.mem_range, beq_iff_eq] at hs ⊢
281	  intro a ha
282	  show R (kiter R (k + 1)) a = R (kiter R k) a
283	  exact h.loc _ _ (fun b hb => hs b hb) a
284	
285	/-- A stable iteration stays stable (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
286	theorem kstab_le {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) {k : Nat}
287	    (hs : kstab R n k = true) : ∀ j, k ≤ j → kstab R n j = true
288	  | j, hj => by
289	    induction j with
290	    | zero => obtain rfl : k = 0 := by omega
291	              exact hs
292	    | succ j ih =>
293	      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k (j + 1) with hlt | hge
294	      · exact kstab_succ h (ih (by omega))
295	      · obtain rfl : k = j + 1 := by omega
296	        exact hs
297	
298	/-- Before stabilizing, each step adds a conclusion (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
299	theorem kstab_exists {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) :
300	    ∀ k, (∃ j, j < k ∧ kstab R n j = true) ∨ k ≤ (List.range n).countP (kiter R k)
301	  | 0 => .inr (Nat.zero_le _)
302	  | k + 1 => by
303	    rcases kstab_exists h k with hj | hc
304	    · obtain ⟨j, hj, hs⟩ := hj; exact .inl ⟨j, by omega, hs⟩
305	    · cases hs : kstab R n k
306	      · obtain ⟨a, ha, hne⟩ := all_false_exists hs
307	        simp only [List.mem_range, beq_eq_false_iff_ne] at ha hne
308	        have hk : kiter R k a = false := by
309	          cases e : kiter R k a
310	          · rfl
311	          · exact absurd (kiter_mono h k a e) (by rw [e] at hne; simpa using hne)
312	        have hk1 : kiter R (k + 1) a = true := by
313	          cases e : kiter R (k + 1) a
314	          · rw [e, hk] at hne; exact absurd rfl hne
315	          · rfl
316	        have := countP_lt_of (l := List.range n) (fun b _ hb => kiter_mono h k b hb)
317	          (List.mem_range.2 ha) hk1 hk
318	        exact .inr (by omega)
319	      · exact .inl ⟨k, by omega, hs⟩
320	
321	/-- The iteration is stable from step `n + 1` on (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
322	theorem kiter_fix {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) (a : Nat) :
323	    kiter R (n + 2) a = kiter R (n + 1) a := by
324	  rcases kstab_exists h (n + 1) with ⟨j, hj, hs⟩ | hc
325	  · have hs' := kstab_le h hs (n + 1) (by omega)
326	    by_cases ha : a < n
327	    · simp only [kstab, List.all_eq_true, List.mem_range, beq_iff_eq] at hs'
328	      exact hs' a ha
329	    · cases e : kiter R (n + 2) a
330	      · cases e' : kiter R (n + 1) a
331	        · rfl
332	        · exact absurd (kiter_bound h _ a e') ha
333	      · exact absurd (kiter_bound h _ a e) ha
334	  · have := List.countP_le_length (p := kiter R (n + 1)) (l := List.range n)
335	    simp at this; omega
336	
337	/-- Monotonicity of the iteration over several steps (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
338	theorem kiter_mono_le {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) :
339	    ∀ j k a, kiter R k a = true → kiter R (k + j) a = true
340	  | 0, _, _, hk => hk
341	  | j + 1, k, a, hk => kiter_mono h _ a (kiter_mono_le h j k a hk)
342	
343	/-- The iteration is constant after step `n + 1` (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
344	theorem kiter_ge {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) :
345	    ∀ j, kiter R (n + 1 + j) = kiter R (n + 1)
346	  | 0 => rfl
347	  | j + 1 => funext fun a => by
348	    show R (kiter R (n + 1 + j)) a = kiter R (n + 1) a
349	    rw [kiter_ge h j]; exact kiter_fix h a
350	
351	/-- A conclusion reached at some step is reached at step `n + 1` (decision procedure for §40 and
352	§43). -/
353	theorem kiter_up {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) :
354	    ∀ k a, kiter R k a = true → kiter R (n + 1) a = true := by
355	  intro k a hk
356	  by_cases hkn : k ≤ n + 1
357	  · have := kiter_mono_le h (n + 1 - k) k a hk
358	    rwa [show k + (n + 1 - k) = n + 1 by omega] at this
359	  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, k = n + 1 + j := ⟨k - (n + 1), by omega⟩
360	    rwa [kiter_ge h j] at hk
361	
362	/-! ## Usable places (§40) -/
363	
364	/-- `Usable(s, p)` (§40, items 1–3): `p` exists, is not marked dead, and its owner is a frame of
365	the stack or a usable place. Inductive, so an ownership cycle makes no place usable (§40). -/
366	inductive S3.Usable (s : S3) : Nat → Prop where
367	  | frame {q f : Nat} {pl : Place} : s.P[q]? = some pl → s.dead q = false →
368	      pl.owner = .frame f → f ∈ s.F → S3.Usable s q
369	  | place {q o : Nat} {pl : Place} : s.P[q]? = some pl → s.dead q = false →
370	      pl.owner = .place o → S3.Usable s o → S3.Usable s q
371	
372	/-- A usable place exists (§40, item 1). -/
373	theorem S3.Usable.lt {s : S3} {q : Nat} (h : s.Usable q) : q < s.P.length := by
374	  cases h <;> exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
375	
376	/-- One step of `Usable` read on a Boolean premise (decision procedure for §40). -/
377	def usableR (s : S3) (U : Nat → Bool) (q : Nat) : Bool :=
378	  match s.P[q]? with
379	  | some pl => !s.dead q && match pl.owner with
380	    | .frame f => decide (f ∈ s.F)
381	    | .place o => decide (o < s.P.length) && U o
382	  | none => false
383	
384	/-- The place case of `usableR` (decision procedure for §40). -/
385	theorem usableR_place {s : S3} {U : Nat → Bool} {q o : Nat} {pl : Place} (hpl : s.P[q]? = some pl)
386	    (hd : s.dead q = false) (ho : pl.owner = .place o) (hlt : o < s.P.length) (hU : U o = true) :
387	    usableR s U q = true := by
388	  simp [usableR, hpl, hd, ho, hlt, hU]
389	
390	/-- `usableR` is a bounded monotone rule (decision procedure for §40). -/
391	theorem usableR_rule (s : S3) : KRule s.P.length (usableR s) where
392	  mono p q hpq a h := by
393	    unfold usableR at h ⊢; split at h
394	    · split at h <;> simp_all
395	    · exact h
396	  bound p a h := by
397	    unfold usableR at h; split at h
398	    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
399	    · cases h
400	  loc p q hpq a := by
401	    unfold usableR; split
402	    · split
403	      · rfl
404	      · rename_i o _; by_cases ho : o < s.P.length <;> simp [ho, hpq o]
405	    · rfl
406	
407	/-- Soundness of the iteration for `Usable` (decision procedure for §40). -/
408	theorem usable_of_kiter (s : S3) : ∀ k q, kiter (usableR s) k q = true → s.Usable q
409	  | 0, _, h => by simp [kiter] at h
410	  | k + 1, q, h => by
411	    simp only [kiter, usableR] at h
412	    split at h
413	    · rename_i pl hpl
414	      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true'] at h
415	      obtain ⟨hd, h⟩ := h
416	      split at h
417	      · exact .frame hpl hd ‹_› (by simpa using h)
418	      · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h
419	        exact .place hpl hd ‹_› (usable_of_kiter s k _ h.2)
420	    · cases h
421	
422	/-- `Usable` is computed by `|P| + 1` steps of `usableR` (decision procedure for §40). -/
423	theorem usable_iff {s : S3} {q : Nat} :
424	    s.Usable q ↔ kiter (usableR s) (s.P.length + 1) q = true := by
425	  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, usable_of_kiter s _ q⟩
426	  induction h with
427	  | frame hpl hd ho hf =>
428	    show usableR s _ _ = true
429	    simp [usableR, hpl, hd, ho, hf]
430	  | place hpl hd ho hu ih =>
431	    rw [← kiter_fix (usableR_rule s)]
432	    show usableR s _ _ = true
433	    exact usableR_place hpl hd ho hu.lt ih

435	/-- Decidability of `Usable` (§40). -/
436	instance (s : S3) (q : Nat) : Decidable (s.Usable q) := decidable_of_iff _ usable_iff.symm
437	
438	/-- Live holder (§49.8): a frame of the stack or a usable place. -/
439	def HolderLive (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
440	  | .frame f => f ∈ s.F
441	  | .place p => s.Usable p
442	
443	/-- Decidability of `HolderLive` (§49.8). -/
444	instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderLive s h) := by
445	  cases h <;> unfold HolderLive <;> infer_instance

447	/-! ## Frame of a place (§40, §44) -/
448	
449	/-- Frame ending the ownership chain of `q`, searched within `k` steps (`placeFrame`, §40). -/
450	def pframeF (s : S3) : Nat → Nat → Option Nat
451	  | 0, _ => none
452	  | k + 1, q =>
453	    match s.P[q]? with
454	    | some pl =>
455	      match pl.owner with
456	      | .frame f => some f
457	      | .place o => pframeF s k o
458	    | none => none
459	
460	/-- `placeFrame(q)` (§40): the frame ending the ownership chain of `q`, within `|P| + 1`
461	steps. -/
462	def S3.pframe (s : S3) (q : Nat) : Option Nat := pframeF s (s.P.length + 1) q
463	
464	/-- Frame of a holder (§44): the frame itself, or the frame of the holding place. -/
465	def S3.hframe (s : S3) : Holder → Option Nat
466	  | .frame f => some f
467	  | .place p => s.pframe p
468	
469	/-- `FrameOf s q f` (§40, `placeFrame`; §49.3): the ownership chain of `q` is finite and ends at
470	frame `f`. -/
471	inductive FrameOf (s : S3) : Nat → Nat → Prop where
472	  | frame {q f : Nat} {pl : Place} : s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f → FrameOf s q f
473	  | place {q o f : Nat} {pl : Place} : s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o → FrameOf s o f →
474	      FrameOf s q f
475	
476	/-- A place with a frame exists (§40). -/
477	theorem FrameOf.lt {s : S3} {q f : Nat} (h : FrameOf s q f) : q < s.P.length := by
478	  cases h <;> exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
479	
480	/-- One step of `FrameOf s · f` read on a Boolean premise (decision procedure for §40). -/
481	def frR (s : S3) (f : Nat) (U : Nat → Bool) (q : Nat) : Bool :=
482	  match s.P[q]? with
483	  | some pl => match pl.owner with
484	    | .frame g => decide (g = f)
485	    | .place o => decide (o < s.P.length) && U o
486	  | none => false
487	
488	/-- `frR` is a bounded monotone rule (decision procedure for §40). -/
489	theorem frR_rule (s : S3) (f : Nat) : KRule s.P.length (frR s f) where
490	  mono p q hpq a h := by
491	    unfold frR at h ⊢; split at h
492	    · split at h <;> simp_all
493	    · exact h
494	  bound p a h := by
495	    unfold frR at h; split at h
496	    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
497	    · cases h
498	  loc p q hpq a := by
499	    unfold frR; split
500	    · split
501	      · rfl
502	      · rename_i o _; by_cases ho : o < s.P.length <;> simp [ho, hpq o]
503	    · rfl
504	
505	/-- `pframeF` is the iteration of `frR` (decision procedure for §40). -/
506	theorem pframeF_kiter (s : S3) (f : Nat) :
507	    ∀ k q, pframeF s k q = some f ↔ kiter (frR s f) k q = true
508	  | 0, q => by simp [pframeF, kiter]
509	  | k + 1, q => by
510	    simp only [pframeF, kiter, frR]
511	    split
512	    · split
513	      · simp
514	      · rename_i o _
515	        by_cases hlt : o < s.P.length
516	        · simp [hlt, pframeF_kiter s f k o]
517	        · simp only [hlt, decide_false, Bool.false_and]
518	          cases k with
519	          | zero => simp [pframeF]
520	          | succ k => simp [pframeF, List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (Nat.le_of_not_lt hlt)]
521	    · simp
522	
523	/-- Soundness of the iteration for `FrameOf` (decision procedure for §40). -/
524	theorem frameOf_of_kiter (s : S3) (f : Nat) : ∀ k q, kiter (frR s f) k q = true → FrameOf s q f
525	  | 0, _, h => by simp [kiter] at h
526	  | k + 1, q, h => by
527	    simp only [kiter, frR] at h
528	    split at h
529	    · rename_i pl hpl
530	      split at h
531	      · rename_i g hg; simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at h; subst h; exact .frame hpl hg
532	      · rename_i o ho; simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h
533	        exact .place hpl ho (frameOf_of_kiter s f k o h.2)
534	    · cases h
535	
536	/-- `pframe` computes `FrameOf` (§40, `placeFrame`). -/
537	theorem pframe_iff {s : S3} {q f : Nat} : s.pframe q = some f ↔ FrameOf s q f := by
538	  rw [S3.pframe, pframeF_kiter]
539	  refine ⟨frameOf_of_kiter s f _ q, fun h => ?_⟩
540	  induction h with
541	  | frame hpl ho => exact kiter_up (frR_rule s _) 1 _ (by simp [kiter, frR, hpl, ho])
542	  | place hpl ho hf ih =>
543	    apply kiter_up (frR_rule s _) (s.P.length + 2) _
544	    show frR s _ (kiter (frR s _) (s.P.length + 1)) _ = true
545	    simp [frR, hpl, ho, ih, hf.lt]
546	
547	/-! ## Transitive ownership (§40) -/
548	
549	/-- One step of `OwnedIn P src` read on a Boolean premise (decision procedure for §40). -/
550	def owR (P : List Place) (src : Nat) (U : Nat → Bool) (q : Nat) : Bool :=
551	  match P[q]? with
552	  | some pl => match pl.owner with
553	    | .place o => decide (partOf P o src) || (decide (o < P.length) && U o)
554	    | .frame _ => false
555	  | none => false
556	
557	/-- A place owned through the value at `src` exists (§40). -/
558	theorem OwnedIn.lt {P : List Place} {src q : Nat} (h : OwnedIn P src q) : q < P.length := by
559	  cases h <;> exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
560	
561	/-- `owR` is a bounded monotone rule (decision procedure for §40). -/
562	theorem owR_rule (P : List Place) (src : Nat) : KRule P.length (owR P src) where
563	  mono p q hpq a h := by
564	    unfold owR at h ⊢; split at h
565	    · split at h
566	      · simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h ⊢
567	        rcases h with h | ⟨h1, h2⟩
568	        · exact .inl h
569	        · exact .inr ⟨h1, hpq _ h2⟩
570	      · exact h
571	    · exact h
572	  bound p a h := by
573	    unfold owR at h; split at h
574	    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
575	    · cases h
576	  loc p q hpq a := by
577	    unfold owR; split
578	    · split
579	      · rename_i o _; by_cases ho : o < P.length <;> simp [ho, hpq o]
580	      · rfl
581	    · rfl
582	
583	/-- Soundness of the iteration for `OwnedIn` (decision procedure for §40). -/
584	theorem ownedIn_of_kiter (P : List Place) (src : Nat) :
585	    ∀ k q, kiter (owR P src) k q = true → OwnedIn P src q
586	  | 0, _, h => by simp [kiter] at h
587	  | k + 1, q, h => by
588	    simp only [kiter, owR] at h
589	    split at h
590	    · rename_i pl hpl
591	      split at h
592	      · rename_i o ho
593	        simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
594	        rcases h with h | ⟨-, h⟩
595	        · exact .direct hpl ho h
596	        · exact .step hpl ho (ownedIn_of_kiter P src k o h)
597	      · cases h
598	    · cases h
599	
600	/-- `OwnedIn` is computed by `|P| + 1` steps of `owR` (decision procedure for §40). -/
601	theorem ownedIn_iff {P : List Place} {src q : Nat} :
602	    OwnedIn P src q ↔ kiter (owR P src) (P.length + 1) q = true := by
603	  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, ownedIn_of_kiter P src _ q⟩
604	  induction h with
605	  | direct hpl ho hp => exact kiter_up (owR_rule P src) 1 _ (by simp [kiter, owR, hpl, ho, hp])
606	  | step hpl ho ho' ih =>
607	    apply kiter_up (owR_rule P src) (P.length + 2) _
608	    show owR P src (kiter (owR P src) (P.length + 1)) _ = true
609	    simp [owR, hpl, ho, ih, ho'.lt]
610	
611	/-- Decidability of `OwnedIn` (§40). -/
612	instance (P : List Place) (src q : Nat) : Decidable (OwnedIn P src q) :=
613	  decidable_of_iff _ ownedIn_iff.symm

615	/-! ## Effective modes (§43) -/
616	
617	/-- Modes of the active descendants of `a` whose footprint covers leaf `p` (§43). -/
618	def descModes (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : List Mode :=
619	  (List.range s.A.length).filterMap fun j =>
620	    match s.A[j]? with
621	    | some y => if y.active = true ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ a ∈ s.ancs j then some y.mode else none
622	    | none => none
623	
624	/-- Cases 2–4 of §43 for an active authority of own mode `m` covering the leaf, whose covering
625	active descendants have modes `ds`. -/
626	def effOf (m : Mode) (ds : List Mode) : Option Mode :=
627	  if ds = [] then some m else if Mode.modify ∈ ds then none else some .observe
628	
629	/-- `effective(s, a, l)` (§43, cases 1–4), computed per leaf. -/
630	def effective (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Option Mode :=
631	  match s.A[a]? with
632	  | some x => if x.active = true ∧ p ∈ x.footprint then effOf x.mode (descModes s a p) else none
633	  | none => none
634	
635	/-- Compatible effective modes for independent ordinary accesses: only `Observe`/`Observe`
636	(§50). -/
637	def Compat (m₁ m₂ : Mode) : Prop := m₁ = .observe ∧ m₂ = .observe
638	
639	/-- Effective mode `e` permits the requested mode `m`: present and not exceeded (§43). -/
640	def Allows (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Prop := OptP e (fun e => m.le e) False
641	
642	/-- Decidability of `Allows` (§43). -/
643	instance (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Decidable (Allows e m) := by
644	  unfold Allows; infer_instance
645	
646	/-- Footprint of authority `a` (§42), empty if it does not exist. -/
647	def S3.afp (s : S3) (a : Nat) : List Nat := match s.A[a]? with
648	  | some x => x.footprint
649	  | none => []
650	
651	/-- Adds an authority with fresh identity `s.A.length` (§42, §60). -/
652	def S3.addAuth (s : S3) (y : Authority) : S3 := { s with A := s.A ++ [y] }
653	
654	/-! ## Exercisable authorities (§43) -/
655	
656	/-- `ExercisableAt(s, a, m)` (§43): `a` is active, its own mode permits `m`, and it is held by
657	the current frame, or by a place `p` such that an authority itself exercisable at `m` has an
658	effective mode permitting `m` on every leaf of `p`. Inductive along the holder chain (§43), so no
659	holder cycle justifies a right. -/
660	inductive S3.ExercisableAt (s : S3) : Nat → Mode → Prop where
661	  | base {a : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true → m.le y.mode →
662	      y.holder = .frame s.top → S3.ExercisableAt s a m
663	  | held {a p b : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
664	      m.le y.mode → y.holder = .place p → S3.ExercisableAt s b m →
665	      (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) → S3.ExercisableAt s a m
666	
667	/-- One step of `ExercisableAt · m` read on a Boolean premise (decision procedure for §43). -/
668	def exR (s : S3) (m : Mode) (E : Nat → Bool) (a : Nat) : Bool :=
669	  match s.A[a]? with
670	  | some y => y.active && decide (m.le y.mode) && match y.holder with
671	    | .frame f => decide (f = s.top)
672	    | .place p => (List.range s.A.length).any fun b =>
673	        decide (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) && E b
674	  | none => false
675	
676	/-- `any` depends only on the values of the predicate on the list (decision procedure for
677	§43). -/
678	theorem any_congr' {α : Type} {f g : α → Bool} : ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ b ∈ l, f b = g b) →
679	    l.any f = l.any g
680	  | [], _ => rfl
681	  | a :: l, h => by
682	    simp only [List.any_cons, h a (List.mem_cons_self ..),
683	      any_congr' fun b hb => h b (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hb)]
684	
685	/-- `exR` is a bounded monotone rule (decision procedure for §43). -/
686	theorem exR_rule (s : S3) (m : Mode) : KRule s.A.length (exR s m) where
687	  mono p q hpq a h := by
688	    unfold exR at h ⊢; split at h
689	    · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h ⊢
690	      refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩; split at h
691	      · simpa using h.2
692	      · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, List.any_eq_true] at h ⊢
693	        obtain ⟨b, hb, hc, he⟩ := h.2
694	        exact ⟨b, hb, hc, hpq b he⟩
695	    · exact h
696	  bound p a h := by
697	    unfold exR at h; split at h
698	    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
699	    · cases h
700	  loc p q hpq a := by
701	    unfold exR; split
702	    · congr 1; split
703	      · rfl
704	      · exact any_congr' fun b hb => by rw [hpq b (List.mem_range.1 hb)]
705	    · rfl
706	
707	/-- Soundness of the iteration for `ExercisableAt` (decision procedure for §43). -/
708	theorem exercisableAt_of_kiter (s : S3) (m : Mode) :
709	    ∀ k a, kiter (exR s m) k a = true → s.ExercisableAt a m
710	  | 0, _, h => by simp [kiter] at h
711	  | k + 1, a, h => by
712	    simp only [kiter, exR] at h
713	    split at h
714	    · rename_i y hy
715	      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
716	      obtain ⟨⟨ha, hm⟩, h⟩ := h
717	      split at h
718	      · rename_i f hf; exact .base hy ha hm (by simp at h; rw [hf, h])
719	      · rename_i p hp
720	        simp only [List.any_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
721	        obtain ⟨b, -, hc, hb⟩ := h
722	        exact .held hy ha hm hp (exercisableAt_of_kiter s m k b hb) hc
723	    · cases h
724	
725	/-- The frame-held case of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
726	theorem exR_base {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a : Nat} {y : Authority}
727	    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode)
728	    (hf : y.holder = .frame s.top) : exR s m E a = true := by
729	  unfold exR; rw [hy]; simp [ha, hm, hf]
730	
731	/-- The place-held case of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
732	theorem exR_held {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a p b : Nat} {y : Authority}
733	    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode) (hp : y.holder = .place p)
734	    (hb : b < s.A.length) (hc : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m)
735	    (hE : E b = true) : exR s m E a = true := by
736	  simp only [exR, hy, ha, hp, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
737	    List.any_eq_true, List.mem_range]
738	  exact ⟨hm, b, hb, hc, hE⟩
739	
740	/-- `ExercisableAt` is computed by `|A| + 1` steps of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
741	theorem exercisableAt_iff {s : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} :
742	    s.ExercisableAt a m ↔ kiter (exR s m) (s.A.length + 1) a = true := by
743	  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, exercisableAt_of_kiter s m _ a⟩
744	  induction h with
745	  | base hy ha hm hf => exact exR_base hy ha hm hf
746	  | held hy ha hm hp hb hc ih =>
747	    rw [← kiter_fix (exR_rule s _)]
748	    have hb' := kiter_bound (exR_rule s _) _ _ ih
749	    exact exR_held hy ha hm hp hb' hc ih
750	
751	/-- Decidability of `ExercisableAt` (§43). -/
752	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (s.ExercisableAt a m) :=
753	  decidable_of_iff _ exercisableAt_iff.symm
754	
755	/-- `HasRight(s, m, q)` (§43): the current frame has an authority exercisable at `m` whose
756	effective mode permits `m` on every leaf of `q`'s footprint. -/
757	def HasRight (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
758	  ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.ExercisableAt a m ∧
759	    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s a l) m
760	
761	/-- Decidability of `HasRight` (§43). -/
762	instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Decidable (HasRight s m q) := by
763	  unfold HasRight; infer_instance

765	/-! ## Dependencies and anchors (§44) -/
766	
767	/-- Anchors of the value at `q`, inherited from its parts (§44: dependencies of contained values
768	are accounted for transitively). -/
769	def depsOf (s : S3) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
770	  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun r => decide (partOf s.P r q)).flatMap s.D
771	
772	/-- The anchors of every place containing leaf `p` are valid, that is, active (§44; §66.3,
773	§67.3, §68.3). -/
774	def DepsValid (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
775	  ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, partOf s.P p q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x
776	
777	/-- Decidability of `DepsValid` (§44). -/
778	instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (DepsValid s p) :=
779	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ _ ∈ _, _))
780	
781	/-- The frame of the effective anchor of `x` (the frame of its holder) exists and is `fd` or an
782	ancestor of `fd` (§44). -/
783	def EffAnchorOK (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=
784	  OptP (s.A[s.effAnchor x]?) (fun z => OptP (s.hframe z.holder)
785	    (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => ancestor s.F g f) False) False) False
786	
787	/-- Decidability of `EffAnchorOK` (§44). -/
788	instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (EffAnchorOK s x fd) := by
789	  unfold EffAnchorOK; infer_instance
790	
791	/-- `AnchorOrder` (§44, §54): for every anchor `x ∈ D(q)` of a usable place `q`, the frame of the
792	effective anchor of `x` is the frame of `q` or an ancestor. -/
793	def AnchorOrder (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)
794	
795	/-- `AnchorOrder` read on the places of `P` (decision procedure for §44). -/
796	theorem anchorOrder_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrder s ↔
797	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q) :=
798	  ⟨fun h q _ hq => h q hq, fun h q hq => h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq⟩
799	
800	/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrder` (§44). -/
801	instance (s : S3) : Decidable (AnchorOrder s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrder_iff.symm
802	
803	/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44, §54): the rule of `AnchorOrder` for every active authority held by a
804	usable place `q`. -/
805	def AnchorOrderHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
806	  ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
807	    y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)
808	
809	/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` read on the places of `P` and the authorities of `A` (decision procedure for
810	§44). -/
811	theorem anchorOrderHeld_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrderHeld s ↔
812	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length,
813	      OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
814	        EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)) True := by
815	  constructor
816	  · intro h q _ hq x _
817	    unfold OptP; split
818	    · rename_i y hy; exact h q hq x y hy
819	    · trivial
820	  · intro h q hq x y hy ya hh
821	    have := h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))
822	    simp only [OptP, hy] at this; exact this ya hh
823	
824	/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44). -/
825	instance (s : S3) : Decidable (AnchorOrderHeld s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderHeld_iff.symm

827	/-! ## Outcomes (§58) -/
828	
829	/-- `Outcome3 = ok(new_state) | reject | fail` (§58). `fail` leaves the state unchanged and
830	carries none. -/
831	inductive Outcome3 (σ : Type) where
832	  | ok (s : σ)
833	  | reject
834	  | fail
835	
836	/-- A kernel transition other than `alloc` (§58): `ok` with the effect when the preconditions
837	hold, `reject` otherwise; never `fail`. -/

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Basic

/-!
# Access kernel: operations O1–O16

The sixteen kernel operations of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md` §60–§75. Each
operation has a precondition structure with one named field per clause item (or per condition of
an item), each field citing its clause; a `Decidable` instance; an effect function; and a step
relation over `Outcome3` (§58). Every operation except `alloc` is `Guarded` (`ok` or `reject`);
`alloc` may also `fail` (§58, §71). `KStep` is the union of their `ok` transitions.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- `mapI f i l` applies `f` to each element of `l` with its index counted from `i` (used by the
effects of §72 and §73). -/
def mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) : Nat → List α → List β
  | _, [] => []
  | i, a :: l => f i a :: mapI f (i + 1) l

/-! ## O1 `derive` (§60) -/

/-- Effect of `derive(source, region, mode)` (§60, `ok` effect): a new active authority of fresh
identity, origin `src`, mode `m`, footprint `region`, held by the current frame. -/
def deriveEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
  s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, region, .frame s.top, true⟩

/-- Preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
structure DerivePre (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop where
  /-- §60.1: `source` is active. -/
  active : s.Active src
  /-- §60.1: `ExercisableAt(s, source, mode)`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src m
  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` exist. -/
  leaves : ∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` belong to the footprint of `source`. -/
  within : ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src
  /-- §60.2: `mode` does not exceed the effective right of `source` on these leaves. -/
  modeOK : ∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m
  /-- §60.3: the addition preserves I1 (§50): an active authority outside the origin chain of the
  new one and sharing a leaf of `region` has own mode `Observe`, and so has the request. -/
  exclusive : ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
    b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
    True
  /-- §60.4: the new holding frame is the live current frame. -/
  frameLive : s.top ∈ s.F

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
instance (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) :
    Decidable (DerivePre s src region m) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src m ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m) ∧
    (∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
      b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
      True) ∧
    s.top ∈ s.F)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩⟩

/-- `derive` as a relation (§60). -/
def DeriveStep (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (DerivePre s src region m) (deriveEff s src region m)

/-! ## O2 `split` (§61) -/

/-- Effect of `split(source, regions)` (§61, `ok` effect): one active derived `Modify` authority
per region, held by the current frame. -/
def splitEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : S3 :=
  { s with A := s.A ++ rs.map fun r => ⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩ }

/-- Exclusive right already distributed by `src` on leaf `p` (§61.3): an active `Modify`
descendant of `src` covering `p`. -/
def DistribExcl (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ src ∈ s.ancs j ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ y.mode = .modify)
    False

/-- Decidability of `DistribExcl` (§61.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Decidable (DistribExcl s src j p) := by
  unfold DistribExcl; infer_instance

XXXX

  keepsTarget : HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p
  /-- §65.5: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `store` (§65). -/
instance (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePre s a p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
      y.holder = .frame s.top) False ∧ s.Usable p ∧ isLeaf s.P p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
      ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q) ∧
    EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p) ∧ HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p ∧
    AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩⟩

/-- `store` as a relation (§65). -/
def StoreStep (a p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (StorePre s a p) (storeEff s a p)

/-! ## Shapes (§47, §71.1, §72) -/

/-- A local shape as a shape whose elements have no owning element (§71.1, §72: locals and
allocated storage are owned by the receiving holder). -/
def LocalShape.toShape (ls : LocalShape) : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) :=
  ls.map fun e => (e.1, none, e.2)

/-- Owner of element `i` of a shape (§47, §72, §71): its owning element if any, `hd`
otherwise. -/
def shapeOwner (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (hd : Holder) (i : Nat) : Holder :=
  match (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
  | some o => .place o
  | none => hd

/-- Places `P` followed by the elements of a shape (§47, §71, §72): (parent, owning element,
kind), owned by their owning element or by `hd`. -/
def shapeP (P : List Place) (hd : Holder) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
    List Place :=
  P ++ (List.range ls.length).map fun i =>
    ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), shapeOwner ls hd i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩

/-- Well-formed shape at offset `n` (§72.2, §71.1; for statics, the hypothesis recorded for
§47): the parent and the owning element of an element are earlier elements, and a part has the
owning element of its parent. -/
def ShapeOK (n : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  ∀ i ∈ List.range ls.length,
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)) (fun r => n ≤ r ∧ r < n + i ∧
      (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = (ls[r - n]?).bind (·.2.1)) True ∧
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1)) (fun o => n ≤ o ∧ o < n + i) True

/-- Decidability of `ShapeOK` (§72.2, §71.1). -/
instance (n : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Decidable (ShapeOK n ls) := by
  unfold ShapeOK; infer_instance

/-- Indices of the root elements (no parent) of a shape (§40 root places; §47, §71, §72). -/
def rootIdx (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Nat :=
  (List.range ls.length).filter fun i => ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)).isNone

/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` (§72) -/

/-- Places after `enterFrame` (§72, `ok` effect): the locals appended, owned by the new frame. -/
def enterP (s : S3) (ls : LocalShape) : List Place := shapeP s.P (.frame s.nF) ls.toShape

/-- Effect of `enterFrame(params, locals)` (§72, `ok` effect): a new frame `nF` is pushed; the
parameters are now held by it; locals are appended (uninitialized, no anchor, alive, unpinned)
with one active root `Modify` authority per root local, held by the new frame. -/
def enterEff (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : S3 :=
  { F := s.nF :: s.F, nF := s.nF + 1, P := enterP s ls
    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
    A := mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y) 0 s.A ++
      (rootIdx ls.toShape).map fun i =>
        ⟨.modify, none, footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i),
          shapeOwner ls.toShape (.frame s.nF) i, true⟩
    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q
    pin := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.pin q }

/-- Origin protection on entry for parameter `p` in state `s'` (§72.3): if `p` is a `Modify`
authority with direct origin `o`, `o` is exercisable in no mode. -/
def ParamOriginHidden (s' : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s'.A[p]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify →
    OptP y.origin (fun o => ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o .observe ∧ ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o .modify) True) True

/-- Decidability of `ParamOriginHidden` (§72.3). -/
instance (s' : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (ParamOriginHidden s' p) := by
  unfold ParamOriginHidden; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` (§72). The modes/footprints/parameter-passing part of §72.2 is
not represented. -/
structure EnterPre (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
  /-- §72.1: the calling frame, the current frame, is live. -/
  callerLive : s.F ≠ []
  /-- §72.1: each parameter is an active derived authority held by the caller. -/
  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top ∧
    y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- §72.2: the locals form a well-formed shape (each parent is an earlier local). -/
  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- §72.3: origin protection on entry, in the resulting state. -/
  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden (enterEff s ps ls) p
  /-- §72.4: `AnchorOrderHeld` over the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (enterEff s ps ls)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `enterFrame` (§72). -/
instance (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Decidable (EnterPre s ps ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.F ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
      y.holder = .frame s.top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧ ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden (enterEff s ps ls) p) ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (enterEff s ps ls))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `enterFrame` as a relation (§72). -/
def EnterStep (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (EnterPre s ps ls) (enterEff s ps ls)

/-! ## O7 `exitFrame` (§73) -/

/-- Authority `x` survives the exit to stack `F₀` (§73.4): active and held by a surviving frame
or by a usable place whose terminal owner survives. -/
def Survives (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ HolderLive { s with F := F₀ } y.holder) False

/-- Decidability of `Survives` (§73.4). -/
instance (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Decidable (Survives s F₀ x) := by
  unfold Survives; infer_instance

/-- First surviving authority of a list (§73.4). -/
def firstSurv (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (l : List Nat) : Option Nat :=
  l.find? fun z => decide (Survives s F₀ z)

/-- Authority `a` after the exit (§73, `ok` effect): released unless it survives; a surviving
derived authority is reanchored to the first surviving active origin of its chain. -/
def exitG (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (a : Nat) (y : Authority) : Authority :=
  if Survives s F₀ a then
    match y.origin with
    | none => y
    | some _ => { y with origin := firstSurv s F₀ (s.ancs a) }
  else { y with active := false }

/-- Effect of `exitFrame` (§73, `ok` effect): the current frame is popped; authorities that do
not survive are released; surviving derived authorities and the anchors of `D` are reanchored to
the first surviving authority of their chains. -/
def exitEff (s : S3) : S3 :=
  { s with
    F := s.F.tail
    D := fun q => (s.D q).map fun x => (firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x)).getD x
    A := mapI (exitG s s.F.tail) 0 s.A }

/-- Preconditions of `exitFrame` (§73). The result clause of §73.2 is not represented. -/
structure ExitPre (k : K) (s : S3) : Prop where
  /-- §73.1: the current frame is not the initial frame and has a surviving caller. -/
  hasCaller : s.F.tail ≠ []
  /-- §73.2, §73.4, §73.5: every anchor of a place usable after the exit has a surviving
  authority among itself and its origins. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x) ≠ none
  /-- §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives s s.F.tail a → s.org a ≠ none →
    firstSurv s s.F.tail (s.ancs a) ≠ none
  /-- §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned, statically or
  dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q →
    ¬ ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
  /-- §73.5: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (exitEff s)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `exitFrame` (§73). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) : Decidable (ExitPre k s) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.F.tail ≠ [] ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives s s.F.tail a → s.org a ≠ none →
      firstSurv s s.F.tail (s.ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ¬ ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeld (exitEff s))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `exitFrame` as a relation (§73). -/
def ExitStep (k : K) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (ExitPre k s) (exitEff s)

/-- Leaf `l` belongs to a usable place (§66.1, §67.1, §68.1). -/

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Ops

/-!
# Access kernel: invariants, initial state, reachability

`WF3` (§49), `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53), `NoDangling` and `NoOrphan` (§54), `Inv3` (§57), the declared
statics and `S3.init` (§47), `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75), and reachability from `S3.init statics`
under the kernel steps O1–O16 (§57). `AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) are in
`Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Basic`, since operations read them.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Root places and root authorities (§40, §49) -/

/-- Root place (§40): an existing place with no structural parent. -/
def RootPlace (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Prop := r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = none

/-- Decidability of `RootPlace` (§40). -/
instance (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Decidable (RootPlace P r) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

/-- `RootChain` (§49.6): the origin chain of an authority covering a leaf ends at a root
authority (no origin) whose footprint is the footprint of a root place containing that leaf. -/
def RootChain (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s.A[a]? = some y → l ∈ y.footprint → isLeaf s.P l →
    ∃ x z r, (x = a ∨ x ∈ s.ancs a) ∧ s.A[x]? = some z ∧ z.origin = none ∧ RootPlace s.P r ∧
      partOf s.P l r ∧ ∀ l', l' ∈ z.footprint ↔ l' ∈ footprint s.P r

/-- `RootHeld` (§49.7, §40): every usable root place has an active root authority of own mode
`Modify`, with no origin, held by the owner of the place, whose footprint is the footprint of the
place. -/
def RootHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ r, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r → ∃ (i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place),
    s.A[i]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧ z.mode = .modify ∧
    s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r

/-- Auxiliary converse of `RootHeld` (§40, §49.7), not a clause of `WF3`: an authority with no
origin is held by the owner of the root place of every leaf it covers. -/
def RootHeldConv (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint →
    RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r → ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner

/-! ## `WF3` (§49) -/

/-- `WF3(s)` (§49): one field per item of §49. Index order of parents and origins represents
acyclicity (§49, last paragraph). -/
structure WF3 (s : S3) : Prop where
  /-- §49.1: the stack is nonempty and duplicate-free, every frame below `nF`. -/
  frames : s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF
  /-- §49.2: parent links are valid and acyclic (the parent precedes the child); a part shares
  its parent's owner and death marker. -/
  places : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q
  /-- §49.3: owner frames are below `nF`; owner places exist; the ownership chain of every usable
  place is finite and reaches a live frame. -/
  owners : (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f →
      f < s.nF) ∧
    (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o →
      o < s.P.length) ∧
    ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∃ f, FrameOf s q f ∧ f ∈ s.F
  /-- §49.4: footprints consist of leaves of existing places. -/
  footprints : ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint,
    l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
  /-- §49.5: an existing origin precedes the authority, so origin chains are acyclic and end at a
  root authority. -/
  origins : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b
  /-- §49.6: `RootChain`. -/
  rootChain : RootChain s
  /-- §49.7: `RootHeld`. -/
  rootHeld : RootHeld s
  /-- §49.8: every active authority is held by a frame of the stack or by a usable place. -/
  holders : ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
    HolderLive s y.holder

/-! ## `I1`–`I4`, `NoDangling`, `Inv3` (§50–§54, §57) -/

/-- `I1` (§50): two distinct active authorities unrelated by derivation covering a common leaf
both have own mode `Observe`. -/
def I1 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b : Nat) (x y : Authority) (p : Nat), a ≠ b → s.A[a]? = some x → s.A[b]? = some y →
    x.active = true → y.active = true → p ∈ x.footprint → p ∈ y.footprint →
    a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a → x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe

/-- `I2` (§51): the origin of a derived authority exists; the derived mode does not exceed the
origin's and the derived footprint is within the origin's. -/
def I2 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a →
    ∃ x : Authority, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ y.mode.le x.mode ∧ ∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint

/-- `I3` (§52): every anchor of a usable place is valid (active). -/
def I3 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x

/-- `I4` (§53, first sentence): no read of a region containing a `Moved` leaf is permitted. -/
def I4 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (l : Nat), l ∈ ls → s.I l = .moved →
  ¬ Read3Pre s a ls

/-- `I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4` (§57). -/
def Inv3base (s : S3) : Prop := I1 s ∧ I2 s ∧ I3 s ∧ I4 s

/-- `NoDangling` (§54): no active authority covers a leaf of an unusable place. -/
def NoDangling (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
    ∀ q, ¬ s.Usable q → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint

/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling` (§57). -/
def Inv3 (s : S3) : Prop := Inv3base s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ NoDangling s

/-! ## `NoOrphan` (§54) -/

/-- One link of a `NoOrphan` chain (§54): `a` is active and structurally covers every leaf of the
place holding `b`. -/
def CoversHolder (s : S3) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun z => match z.holder with
    | .place q => s.Active a ∧ ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ s.afp a
    | .frame _ => False) False

/-- Consecutive elements of a list are related by `R` (§54, chains of `NoOrphan`). -/
def Linked (R : Nat → Nat → Prop) : List Nat → Prop
  | a :: b :: c => R a b ∧ Linked R (b :: c)
  | _ => True

/-- `NoOrphan` (§54): every active authority held by a place ends a finite, non-repeating chain of
authorities whose first link is active and held by a frame of the stack, each link covering the
whole place holding the next. -/
def NoOrphan (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
    ∃ (a₀ : Nat) (z : Authority) (f : Nat) (c : List Nat), s.A[a₀]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧
      z.holder = .frame f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ (a₀ :: c).Nodup ∧ (a₀ :: c).getLast? = some x ∧
      Linked (CoversHolder s) (a₀ :: c)

/-! ## Initial state (§47) -/

/-- Declared static storage (§47): each element is (parent, owning static, kind) with its
initial state, `true` for `Init` and `false` for `Uninit` (read on leaves only). -/
abbrev Statics := List ((Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool)

/-- Well-formed statics declaration (§47; not stated by §47, a hypothesis of the theorems on the
initial state): parents and owning statics are earlier statics, and a part has its parent's
owning static. -/

/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, A5) -/

/-- Owner of the local of index `i` of `ls` (parent, owning local, kind) in the new frame `f`:
the owning local if any, the new frame otherwise (A5). -/
def localOwner (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (f i : Nat) : Holder :=
  match (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
  | some o => .place o
  | none => .frame f

/-- Places after `enterFrame`: the locals `ls` appended, owned by the new frame `nF` or by an
earlier local (A5). -/
def enterP (s : S3) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Place :=
  s.P ++ (List.range ls.length).map fun i =>
    ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), localOwner ls s.nF i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩

/-- Indices, relative to `ls`, of the root locals (no parent). -/
def rootIdx (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Nat :=
  (List.range ls.length).filter fun i => ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)).isNone

/-- Effect of `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O6) with parameters `ps` and locals `ls`: new frame
`nF` pushed; the parameters, held by the caller, are now held by the new frame (A3); locals
appended, uninitialised, without dependency, alive and unpinned; one active root `Modify`
authority per root local on its footprint, held by the owner of the local (pass-1
arbitrage 2; A4); the ghost record `callParams` of the new frame is `ps` (F6). -/
def enterEff (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : S3 :=
  { F := s.nF :: s.F, nF := s.nF + 1, P := enterP s ls
    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
    A := mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y) 0 s.A ++
      (rootIdx ls).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i), localOwner ls s.nF i, true⟩
    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q
    freed := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.freed q
    pin := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.pin q
    arenas := s.arenas
    callParams := fun f => if f = s.nF then ps else s.callParams f }

/-- G1, for one parameter `p` and the state `s'` where the new frame has received its parameters:
if `p` is a `Modify` authority with an origin, that origin, its direct origin only, is
exercisable (A2, B2) at no mode in `s'`. -/
def ParamOriginHidden (s' : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s'.A[p]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify →
    OptP y.origin (fun o => ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o .observe ∧ ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o .modify) True) True

instance (s' : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (ParamOriginHidden s' p) := by
  unfold ParamOriginHidden; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` before G1 and G4 (MM-03.3 §4, O6): the calling frame is active
(non-empty stack); each parameter is an active derived authority (`origin ≠ none`) held by the
caller (A3, read since pass 2 without requiring the caller to be the deriving frame); the parent
and the owner of a local are earlier locals; a part has the owner of its parent. -/
def EnterPreBase (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  s.F ≠ [] ∧
  (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top ∧
    y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
  ∀ i ∈ List.range ls.length,
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)) (fun r => s.P.length ≤ r ∧ r < s.P.length + i ∧
      (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = (ls[r - s.P.length]?).bind (·.2.1)) True ∧
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1)) (fun o => s.P.length ≤ o ∧ o < s.P.length + i) True

instance (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
    Decidable (EnterPreBase s ps ls) := by
  unfold EnterPreBase; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O6): those of `EnterPreBase`; G1: in
`enterEff s ps ls`, the state where the new frame has received its parameters, the direct origin of
every `Modify` parameter is exercisable at no mode (`ParamOriginHidden`); G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in
the arrival state. -/
def EnterPre (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  EnterPreBase s ps ls ∧ (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden (enterEff s ps ls) p) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeld (enterEff s ps ls)

instance (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
    Decidable (EnterPre s ps ls) := by
  unfold EnterPre; infer_instance

/-- `enterFrame` as a relation (MM-03.3 §4, O6; A3). -/
def EnterStep (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (s : S3) :
    Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (EnterPre s ps ls) (enterEff s ps ls)

/-! ## O7 `exitFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, A4, A5, A7) -/

/-- Authority `x` survives the exit to stack `F₀`: active, and held by a holder still live once
the frame is popped, through transitive ownership (A4, A5). A7 speaks of an authority held by
a surviving frame; an authority held by a place is read as held by the frame that ends its
owner chain. -/
def Survives (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ HolderLive { s with F := F₀ } y.holder) False

instance (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Decidable (Survives s F₀ x) := by
  unfold Survives; infer_instance

/-- First surviving authority of a list (A7). -/
def firstSurv (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (l : List Nat) : Option Nat :=
  l.find? fun z => decide (Survives s F₀ z)

/-- Authority `a` after the exit (MM-03.3 §4, O7; A7): released unless it survives; a surviving
authority is re-attached to its first surviving strict ancestor along `origin`, which is its
origin when that origin survives. -/
def exitG (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (a : Nat) (y : Authority) : Authority :=
  if Survives s F₀ a then
    match y.origin with
    | none => y
    | some _ => { y with origin := firstSurv s F₀ (s.ancs a) }
  else { y with active := false }

/-- Effect of `exitFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O7; A4; A5; A7): return to the caller; each anchor
replaced by the first surviving authority among itself and its ancestors; authorities that do
not survive released; surviving derived authorities re-attached. -/
def exitEff (s : S3) : S3 :=
  match s.F with
  | _ :: F₀ =>
    { s with
      F := F₀
      D := fun q => (s.D q).map fun x => (firstSurv s F₀ (x :: s.ancs x)).getD x
      A := mapI (exitG s F₀) 0 s.A }
  | [] => s

/-- Preconditions of `exitFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O7; A7; B4): the exiting frame has a caller; every
anchor of a place still usable after the exit has a surviving authority among itself and its
ancestors along `origin`; every surviving derived authority has a surviving strict ancestor;
B4: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame, transitively owned storage included, is
pinned, dynamically (A8) or statically (`Pinned`, MM-03.3.8); G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the arrival
state, after the re-anchoring. Otherwise the exit is rejected. -/
def ExitPre (k : K) (s : S3) : Prop :=
  match s.F with
  | _ :: F₀ => F₀ ≠ [] ∧
      (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s with F := F₀ } : S3).Usable q →
        ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv s F₀ (x :: s.ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
      (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives s F₀ a → s.org a ≠ none →
        firstSurv s F₀ (s.ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
      (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ¬ ({ s with F := F₀ } : S3).Usable q →
        ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
      AnchorOrderHeld (exitEff s)
  | [] => False

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) : Decidable (ExitPre k s) := by
  unfold ExitPre; split <;> infer_instance

/-- `exitFrame` as a relation (MM-03.3 §4, O7). -/
def ExitStep (k : K) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (ExitPre k s) (exitEff s)

/-! ## Abstract reads and writes (MM-03.3 §5) -/

/-- Ordinary read condition of a leaf by authority `a` (MM-03.3 §5, `canRead3`): an effective
authority permits observation, the leaf is initialised, the needed dependencies are valid. The

/-! ## Preservation by `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O6; A3; A5) -/

theorem enterP_len (s : S3) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
    (enterP s ls).length = s.P.length + ls.length := by simp [enterP]

theorem enterP_lt {s : S3} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {q : Nat}
    (h : q < s.P.length) : (enterP s ls)[q]? = s.P[q]? := List.getElem?_append_left h

theorem enterP_new {s : S3} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {i : Nat}
    (h : i < ls.length) : (enterP s ls)[s.P.length + i]? =
      some ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), localOwner ls s.nF i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩ := by
  simp only [enterP, List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_add_right _ _), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left,
    List.getElem?_map, List.getElem?_range h, Option.map_some]

theorem enterP_get {s : S3} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {q : Nat} {pl : Place}
    (h : (enterP s ls)[q]? = some pl) :
    (q < s.P.length ∧ s.P[q]? = some pl) ∨ (s.P.length ≤ q ∧ ∃ i, i < ls.length ∧
      q = s.P.length + i ∧ pl = ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), localOwner ls s.nF i,
        ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩) := by
  by_cases hq : q < s.P.length
  · exact .inl ⟨hq, by rwa [enterP_lt hq] at h⟩
  · have hi : q - s.P.length < ls.length := by
      have := lt_of_getElem? h; rw [enterP_len] at this; omega
    have e : q = s.P.length + (q - s.P.length) := by omega
    rw [e, enterP_new hi] at h; cases h
    exact .inr ⟨by omega, _, hi, e, rfl⟩

theorem enter_get {s : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {j : Nat}
    {z : Authority} (h : (enterEff s ps ls).A[j]? = some z) :
    (j < s.A.length ∧ ∃ y, s.A[j]? = some y ∧
      z = if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y) ∨
    (s.A.length ≤ j ∧ ∃ i, (rootIdx ls)[j - s.A.length]? = some i ∧
      z = ⟨.modify, none, footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i), localOwner ls s.nF i, true⟩) := by
  simp only [enterEff] at h
  by_cases hj : j < s.A.length
  · have hj' : j < (mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y) 0
        s.A).length := by rw [length_mapI]; exact hj
    rw [List.getElem?_append_left hj', getElem?_mapI] at h
    cases hy : s.A[j]? with
    | none => rw [hy] at h; cases h
    | some y => rw [hy] at h; cases h; exact .inl ⟨hj, y, rfl, by simp⟩
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by rw [length_mapI]; omega), length_mapI,
      List.getElem?_map] at h
    cases hi : (rootIdx ls)[j - s.A.length]? with
    | none => rw [hi] at h; cases h
    | some i => rw [hi] at h; cases h; exact .inr ⟨by omega, i, rfl, rfl⟩

theorem enter_lt {s : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {j : Nat}
    (h : j < s.A.length) : (enterEff s ps ls).A[j]? =
      (s.A[j]?).map fun y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y := by
  simp only [enterEff]
  rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by rw [length_mapI]; exact h), getElem?_mapI]; simp

theorem enter_org_lt {s : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    {j : Nat} (h : j < s.A.length) : (enterEff s ps ls).org j = s.org j := by
  simp only [S3.org, enter_lt h]
  cases s.A[j]? with
  | none => rfl
  | some y => simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some]; split <;> rfl

theorem enter_ancs_lt {s : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    {j : Nat} (h : j < s.A.length) : (enterEff s ps ls).ancs j = s.ancs j :=
  chain_congr fun _ hi => enter_org_lt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hi h)

theorem rootIdx_mem {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {k i : Nat}
    (h : (rootIdx ls)[k]? = some i) : i < ls.length ∧ (ls[i]?).bind (·.1) = none := by
  have := List.mem_of_getElem? h
  simp only [rootIdx, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, Option.isNone_iff_eq_none] at this
  exact this

theorem enter_parentOf_new {s : S3} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {i : Nat}
    (h : i < ls.length) : parentOf (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i) = (ls[i]?).bind (·.1) := by
  simp [parentOf, enterP_new h]

theorem enter_parentOf_lt {s : S3} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {q : Nat}
    (h : q < s.P.length) : parentOf (enterP s ls) q = parentOf s.P q := by
  simp [parentOf, enterP_lt h]

theorem enter_root_fp_ge {s : S3} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {i l : Nat}
    (h : l ∈ footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i)) : s.P.length ≤ l := by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, h | h⟩ := mem_footprint.1 h
  · omega
  · have := chain_lt h; omega

theorem enter_roots_disjoint {s : S3} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {i i' l : Nat}
    (hii : i ≠ i') (hn : (ls[i]?).bind (·.1) = none) (hn' : (ls[i']?).bind (·.1) = none)
    (h : l ∈ footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i))
    (h' : l ∈ footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i')) : False := by
  have hlt : ∀ {j}, l ∈ footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + j) → j < ls.length := fun hj => by
    obtain ⟨hl, -, -, hq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hj
    rw [enterP_len] at hl
    rcases hq with hq | hq
    · omega
    · have := chain_lt hq; omega
  have hi := hlt h; have hi' := hlt h'
  have r := enter_parentOf_new (s := s) hi; rw [hn] at r
  have r' := enter_parentOf_new (s := s) hi'; rw [hn'] at r'
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, h | h⟩ := mem_footprint.1 h <;> obtain ⟨-, -, -, h' | h'⟩ := mem_footprint.1 h'
  · omega
  · subst h; rw [chain_none r] at h'; simp at h'
  · subst h'; rw [chain_none r'] at h; simp at h
  · exact hii (by have := chainF_root _ _ _ _ h r h' r'; omega)

/-- New locals are usable once the frame is entered (A5). -/
theorem enter_usable_new {s : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    (hpre : EnterPreBase s ps ls) : ∀ n i, i < n → i < ls.length →
      (enterEff s ps ls).Usable (s.P.length + i)
  | 0, _, h, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, i, _, hi => by
    have hpl := enterP_new (s := s) hi
    have hd : (enterEff s ps ls).dead (s.P.length + i) = false := by simp [enterEff]
    unfold localOwner at hpl
    cases ho : (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
    | none =>
      rw [ho] at hpl
      exact .frame (show (enterP s ls)[_]? = _ from hpl) hd rfl (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    | some o =>
      rw [ho] at hpl
      have h2 := (hpre.2.2 i (List.mem_range.2 hi)).2
      rw [ho] at h2; obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h2
      have := enter_usable_new hpre n (o - s.P.length) (by omega) (by omega)
      rw [show s.P.length + (o - s.P.length) = o by omega] at this
      exact .place (show (enterP s ls)[_]? = _ from hpl) hd rfl this

/-- Old places keep their usability when a frame is entered (A5). -/
theorem enter_usable_old {s : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    {q : Nat} (h : s.Usable q) : (enterEff s ps ls).Usable q := by
  induction h with
  | @frame q f pl hpl hd ho hf =>
    exact .frame (show (enterP s ls)[q]? = _ by rw [enterP_lt (lt_of_getElem? hpl)]; exact hpl)
      (by simp [enterEff, hd]) ho (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hf)
  | @place q o pl hpl hd ho _ ih =>
    exact .place (show (enterP s ls)[q]? = _ by rw [enterP_lt (lt_of_getElem? hpl)]; exact hpl)
      (by simp [enterEff, hd]) ho ih

theorem enter_usable_back {s : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    (hwf : WF3 s) {q : Nat} (h : (enterEff s ps ls).Usable q) (hq : q < s.P.length) :
    s.Usable q := by
  induction h with
  | @frame q f pl hpl hd ho hf =>
    have hpl' : s.P[q]? = some pl := by
      have : (enterP s ls)[q]? = some pl := hpl
      rwa [enterP_lt hq] at this
    have hd' : s.dead q = false := by simpa [enterEff, hq] using hd
    have hlt := hwf.ownerFrame q pl f hpl' ho
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hf with e | hf
    · subst e; exact absurd hlt (Nat.lt_irrefl _)
    · exact .frame hpl' hd' ho hf
  | @place q o pl hpl hd ho _ ih =>
    have hpl' : s.P[q]? = some pl := by
      have : (enterP s ls)[q]? = some pl := hpl
      rwa [enterP_lt hq] at this
    have hd' : s.dead q = false := by simpa [enterEff, hq] using hd
    exact .place hpl' hd' ho (ih (hwf.ownerPlace q pl o hpl' ho))

theorem enter_localOwner_live {s : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    (hpre : EnterPreBase s ps ls) {i : Nat} (hi : i < ls.length) :
    HolderLive (enterEff s ps ls) (localOwner ls s.nF i) := by
  unfold localOwner
  cases ho : (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
  | none => exact List.mem_cons_self ..
  | some o =>
    have h2 := (hpre.2.2 i (List.mem_range.2 hi)).2
    rw [ho] at h2
    have := enter_usable_new hpre (o - s.P.length + 1) (o - s.P.length) (Nat.lt_succ_self _)
      (by simp only [OptP] at h2; omega)
    simp only [OptP] at h2
    rwa [show s.P.length + (o - s.P.length) = o by omega] at this

theorem enter_chain_ge {s : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    (hpre : EnterPreBase s ps ls) : ∀ n q, q < n → s.P.length ≤ q →
      ∀ x ∈ chain (parentOf (enterP s ls)) q, s.P.length ≤ x
  | 0, _, h, _, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, q, hq, hge, x, hx => by
    have hi : q - s.P.length < ls.length := by
      cases hpo : parentOf (enterP s ls) q with
      | none => rw [chain_none hpo] at hx; simp at hx
      | some r =>
        simp only [parentOf] at hpo
        cases h' : (enterP s ls)[q]? with
        | none => rw [h'] at hpo; cases hpo
        | some _ => have := lt_of_getElem? h'; rw [enterP_len] at this; omega
    have hpo := enter_parentOf_new (s := s) hi
    rw [show s.P.length + (q - s.P.length) = q by omega] at hpo
    cases hb : (ls[q - s.P.length]?).bind (·.1) with
    | none => rw [hb] at hpo; rw [chain_none hpo] at hx; simp at hx
    | some r =>
      rw [hb] at hpo
      have h1 := (hpre.2.2 (q - s.P.length) (List.mem_range.2 hi)).1
      rw [hb] at h1; simp only [OptP] at h1
      rw [chain_cons hpo (by omega)] at hx
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hx with rfl | hx
      · omega
      · exact enter_chain_ge hpre n r (by omega) (by omega) x hx

/-- The footprint of an existing place does not change when a frame is entered: new places have
new parents (MM-03.3.2; MM-03.3 §4, O6). -/
theorem enter_footprint_old {s : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    (hpre : EnterPreBase s ps ls) {q : Nat} (hq : q < s.P.length) :
    ∀ l, l ∈ footprint (enterP s ls) q ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P q := by
  have hpar : ∀ j < s.P.length, parentOf (enterP s ls) j = parentOf s.P j :=
    fun j hj => enter_parentOf_lt hj
  have hch : ∀ l < s.P.length, chain (parentOf (enterP s ls)) l = chain (parentOf s.P) l :=
    fun l hl => chain_congr fun j hj => hpar j (by omega)
  intro l
  simp only [mem_footprint, isLeaf, partOf, enterP_len]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hl, hleaf, -, hpo⟩
    have hln : l < s.P.length := by
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge l s.P.length with h | h
      · exact h
      · rcases hpo with rfl | hpo
        · omega
        · have := enter_chain_ge hpre (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) h q hpo; omega
    refine ⟨hln, fun r hr => by rw [← hpar r hr]; exact hleaf r (by omega), hln, ?_⟩
    rwa [hch l hln] at hpo
  · rintro ⟨hl, hleaf, -, hpo⟩
    refine ⟨by omega, fun r hr => ?_, by omega, by rwa [hch l hl]⟩
    by_cases hrn : r < s.P.length
    · rw [hpar r hrn]; exact hleaf r hrn
    · intro he
      have hi : r - s.P.length < ls.length := by omega
      have hpo' := enter_parentOf_new (s := s) hi
      rw [show s.P.length + (r - s.P.length) = r by omega, he] at hpo'
      have h1 := (hpre.2.2 (r - s.P.length) (List.mem_range.2 hi)).1
      rw [← hpo'] at h1; simp only [OptP] at h1; omega

/-- `enterFrame` preserves `RootChain` (B1): old authorities keep their chains and the footprints
of old places are unchanged; each new root authority is the root authority of its local. -/
theorem enter_rootChain {s : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    (hwf : WF3 s) (hpre : EnterPreBase s ps ls) : RootChain (enterEff s ps ls) := by
  intro a y l ha hl hleaf
  rcases enter_get ha with ⟨ha', y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ | ⟨ha', i, hi, rfl⟩
  · have hl0 : l ∈ y₀.footprint := by split at hl <;> exact hl
    have hlt := hwf.fp a y₀ hy₀ l hl0
    have hleaf0 : isLeaf s.P l := fun r hr => by
      have := hleaf r (by show r < (enterP s ls).length; rw [enterP_len]; omega)
      rwa [show parentOf (enterEff s ps ls).P r = parentOf s.P r from enter_parentOf_lt hr] at this
    obtain ⟨x0, z, r, hx0, hz, hzo, ⟨hrl, hrp⟩, ⟨hl', hc⟩, hfz⟩ :=
      hwf.rootChain a y₀ l hy₀ hl0 hleaf0
    have hx0lt : x0 < s.A.length := by
      rcases hx0 with rfl | hx0
      · exact ha'
      · exact Nat.lt_trans (chain_lt hx0) ha'
    refine ⟨x0, _, r, by rw [enter_ancs_lt ha']; exact hx0, by rw [enter_lt hx0lt, hz]; rfl, ?_,
      ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, fun l' => ?_⟩
    · split <;> exact hzo
    · show r < (enterP s ls).length; rw [enterP_len]; omega
    · show parentOf (enterP s ls) r = none; rw [enter_parentOf_lt hrl]; exact hrp
    · show l < (enterP s ls).length; rw [enterP_len]; omega
    · rcases hc with rfl | hc
      · exact .inl rfl
      · right
        show r ∈ chain (parentOf (enterP s ls)) l
        rwa [chain_congr (fun j hj => enter_parentOf_lt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hj hl'))]
    · show _ ↔ l' ∈ footprint (enterP s ls) r
      rw [enter_footprint_old hpre hrl]
      split <;> exact hfz l'
  · obtain ⟨hil, hin⟩ := rootIdx_mem hi
    refine ⟨a, _, s.P.length + i, .inl rfl, ha, rfl, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, (mem_footprint.1 hl).2.2,
      fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
    · show s.P.length + i < (enterP s ls).length; rw [enterP_len]; omega
    · show parentOf (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i) = none; rw [enter_parentOf_new hil]; exact hin

/-- `enterFrame` preserves `RootHeld` (A4): the root of each new local is held by its owner; a
parameter is never a root (A3). -/
theorem enter_rootHeld {s : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    (hwf : WF3 s) (hpre : EnterPreBase s ps ls) (hr : RootHeld s) : RootHeld (enterEff s ps ls) := by
  intro x z l r hx ho hl hrp hlr
  rcases enter_get hx with ⟨-, z₀, hz₀, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, i, hi, rfl⟩
  · have ho' : z₀.origin = none := by split at ho <;> exact ho
    have hl' : l ∈ z₀.footprint := by split at hl <;> exact hl
    have hnp : x ∉ ps := fun hp => by
      have := hpre.2.1 x hp; simp only [OptP, hz₀] at this; exact this.2.2 ho'
    have hlt := hwf.fp x z₀ hz₀ l hl'
    obtain ⟨-, hc⟩ := hlr
    have hch : chain (parentOf (enterP s ls)) l = chain (parentOf s.P) l :=
      chain_congr fun j hj => enter_parentOf_lt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hj hlt)
    have hrl : r < s.P.length := by
      rcases hc with rfl | hc
      · exact hlt
      · have : r ∈ chain (parentOf s.P) l := by rw [← hch]; exact hc

/-- Termination of the walk along origins (A7): the walk from `x` visits at most `x + 1`
authorities, with strictly decreasing identities. -/
theorem reanchor_terminates (s : S3) (x : Nat) :
    (x :: s.ancs x).length ≤ x + 1 ∧ ∀ z ∈ s.ancs x, z < x :=
  ⟨by simp only [List.length_cons]; have := chain_length s.org x; unfold S3.ancs; omega,
   fun _ hz => chain_lt hz⟩

theorem org_lt {s : S3} (hw : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y →
    y.origin = some a → a < b) {x o : Nat} (h : s.org x = some o) : o < x := by
  simp only [S3.org] at h
  cases hy : s.A[x]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at h; cases h
  | some y => rw [hy] at h; exact hw x y o hy h

theorem ancs_cons {s : S3} (hw : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y →
    y.origin = some a → a < b) {x o : Nat} (h : s.org x = some o) :
    s.ancs x = o :: s.ancs o := chain_cons h (org_lt hw h)

/-- Under the order of origins of `WF3`, the walk along origins from `x` (A7) reaches a root:
some authority among `x` and its ancestors has no origin. Without that order, `chain` stops at
the first link that does not decrease. -/
theorem reanchor_reaches_root {s : S3} (hw : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat),
    s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b) :
    ∀ n x, x < n → ∃ r, (r = x ∨ r ∈ s.ancs x) ∧ s.org r = none
  | 0, _, h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, x, hx => by
    cases ho : s.org x with
    | none => exact ⟨x, .inl rfl, ho⟩
    | some o =>
      have hlt := org_lt hw ho
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hro⟩ := reanchor_reaches_root hw n o (by omega)
      refine ⟨r, .inr ?_, hro⟩
      rw [ancs_cons hw ho]
      rcases hr with rfl | hr
      · exact List.mem_cons_self ..
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hr

/-- One step of a chain of origins: the chain from `x` starts with the origin of `x`, which is
smaller, or it is empty. -/
theorem ancs_step {s : S3} {x o : Nat} (h : s.org x = some o) :
    (o < x ∧ s.ancs x = o :: s.ancs o) ∨ s.ancs x = [] := by
  by_cases hlt : o < x
  · exact .inl ⟨hlt, chain_cons h hlt⟩
  · right; unfold S3.ancs chain
    cases x with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k => simp [chainF, h, hlt]

theorem firstSurv_ancs {s : S3} {F₀ : Frames} :

      z ∈ s.ancs x ∧ Survives s F₀ z ∧

    | none => rw [S3.ancs, chain_none ho] at hz; simp [firstSurv] at hz
    | some o =>
      obtain ⟨hlt, he⟩ : o < x ∧ s.ancs x = o :: s.ancs o := by
